title: fix(runtime)!: the package write doors refuse a query parameter they do not read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XJHgKKRa9iGmUbp1paLnPzX)_

Fixes #26857

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc teaches a query parameter these doors would now refuse: `skills/**` names a package write door only in `plugin-hooks.md` (a `publish-drafts` route mention, no query string); `content/docs` teaches `?keepData=true` (`kernel/contracts/metadata-service.mdx`, the generated `references/api/package-api.mdx`) and the QA checklist `?overwrite=true`, both declared names that keep working.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:包的全部写门(卸载、安装、PATCH、启停、发布、回退、回滚、领养孤儿、复制,以及 RestServer 的 `POST /packages/publish`)现在只认自己声明的查询参数,其余一律答 `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`,文案用仓里唯一那句「不认识的查询参数」。
- 为什么改:`DELETE /packages/:id?keepdata=true`(小写拼错)以前被当成没写,卸载照常删掉了调用方要保留的对象表并答 200;真实 SQLite 探针在 main 上复现了「表没了」。
- 风险与回滚:只拒带未声明参数的请求;`?keepData=true`、`?overwrite=true` 与不带参数的调用照旧,控制台与 SDK 都在此列。回滚即还原 `packages.ts` 的 helper 与各门入口一行、`package-routes.ts` 一处。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 的 `refusePackageWriteDoorQuery` 与三个声明集,和 DELETE 门入口那一行(在权限与 wall 闸之后、注册表与协议之前);其次 `packages/rest/src/package-routes.ts` 的发布路由。
- 两分钟验证:`cd packages/runtime && pnpm exec vitest run src/domains/packages-write-doors-closed-query.test.ts`,预期 65 passed;其中 `?keepdata=true` 各例答 400,`deletePackage` 未被调用,包仍在注册表里。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`: #26853's `refuseDraftDoorQuery` is generalised in place into `refusePackageWriteDoorQuery(deps, query, declared)`. Same sentence (`unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage` from `@objectstack/rest`), same `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` through `deps.error`, no new code, no second helper. Each door passes its measured closed set:
  - `DELETE /packages/:id`: `PACKAGE_DELETE_QUERY_PARAMS = ['keepData']` (the door reads `query.keepData` and nothing else).
  - `POST /packages` (install): `PACKAGE_INSTALL_QUERY_PARAMS = ['overwrite']` (every other install option rides the body).
  - every other write door: `PACKAGE_WRITE_NO_QUERY_PARAMS = []` (`PATCH /packages/:id`, `…/enable`, `…/disable`, `POST …/publish`, `…/publish-drafts`, `…/discard-drafts`, `…/revert`, `…/rollback`, `…/commits/:commitId/revert`, `…/adopt-orphans`, `…/duplicate`). Measured from the handlers and the helpers they call (`requireWritablePackage`, `requireDuplicableSource`, `refuseWalledCatalogPackageWrite`, `resolveProtocol`, `installBodyRefusal`): none reads the query. The two draft doors now route through the generalised form; `DRAFT_DOOR_QUERY_PARAMS` became `PACKAGE_WRITE_NO_QUERY_PARAMS`.
- Placement on each door: right after `requireManageMetadata` and `refuseWalledCatalogPackageWrite`, before the registry or the protocol is read or called (the #23214 / #26853 placement), so a refused call deletes, installs or changes nothing. On install it also runs ahead of the body parse. A repeated declared flag stays refused by `refuseRepeatedWriteFlag` at the place it has today; recognition runs before it (AGENTS.md route rule 5), so `?keepData=true&keepData=true&keepdata=true` is answered as the unknown name.
- `packages/rest/src/package-routes.ts`: `RestServer`'s `POST /packages/publish` is still served (the registrar's one route), and it cannot reach the runtime helper. It declares `PACKAGE_PUBLISH_PARAMS = []` and answers the same `unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage` sentence after its capability gate and before the package service is resolved. It writes it through the module's own `sendError`, because this surface answers every body through that wrapped envelope; `refuseUnknownQueryParams` writes the bare nested body the `/meta` routes use. Same sentence, same code, no third phrasing.
- Read-only `GET` doors are not touched.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/rest` patch, `fix(runtime)!:` with both declaration lines and the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition.

### Caller census (this is a narrowing, so measured before the first edit, at `e78d7057`)

Every call to these doors in `ui/**`, `packages/client*/**`, `packages/cli/**`, `skills/**`, `examples/**`, `content/docs/**`, `docs/**` and the repo's test and dogfood trees that sends a query parameter:

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx`: `DELETE …?keepData=true` (structure-only delete). Declared, unchanged.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json`, `platform-core.json`: `POST /api/v1/packages?overwrite=true`, and a doubled `keepData` arity probe. Declared, unchanged (the arity refusal keeps its sentence).
- `packages/runtime/src/domain-handler-registry.test.ts`: `POST /packages` with `{ overwrite: 'true' }`. Declared.
- `packages/client` (`packages.install/uninstall/enable/disable/update/publish/publishDrafts/discardDrafts/revertCommit/rollback/revert/adoptOrphans/duplicate`): no query on any write door (install sends `overwrite` in the body). The client fetch wrapper adds no cache-buster.
- Console `PackagesPage`, `PackageFormDialog`, `StudioDesignSurface`, `packages-io` (`duplicate`), `commitHistory` (`commits/:c/revert`), `MetadataClient.publishPackageDrafts`: no query.
- `packages/cli`: no call to these doors (its `package publish` goes to `/api/v1/cloud/packages`).

No caller sends a name a door now refuses: nothing to fix, no blocker.

## Tests

- New `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-write-doors-closed-query.test.ts`, 65 cases, through `dispatch()` over a real `SchemaRegistry` with a recording protocol and metadata service (the `packages-write-flag-arity` harness):
  - `DELETE /packages/:id`: `?keepdata=true`, `?keep_data=true`, `?KeepData=1`, `?keepData=true&keepdata=true`, `?dryRun=true` each answer `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with exactly `unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage(query, ['keepData'])`; `deletePackage` is never called; the package is still in the registry. Recognition outranks arity. Preservation: `keepData=true` and `keepData=1` still reach `deletePackage({ packageId, keepData: true })`.
  - `POST /packages`: `overwrite=true` still overwrites an installed id (`201`); a misspelled `overWrite` is refused before the install instead of answering the `409` it read as absent.
  - Per door, all eleven: three refusal shapes (an unknown name, the same name repeated, two unknown names) with the act never performed; the call without a query performs the act once and answers as today; a caller without `manage_metadata` still gets `403` first.
- New `packages/rest/src/package-publish-closed-query.test.ts`, 5 cases: refusal (status, code, the shared sentence, `publish` never called), preservation (`200`, `publish` once), `403` first.
- The existing `packages-draft-doors-closed-query.test.ts` (10) and `packages-write-flag-arity.test.ts` (11) pass unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- `Clause-②:` is the claim's line, copied as the os-dev rule requires. Measured on the diff: the accept set narrows and no public surface grows (no export, route or key added), which is the reading the `(narrowing)` arm describes; the seat may prefer `no (narrowing)`, as the line's own question (does this widen the accept set or grow the public surface) answers no. `Check Changeset` reads `none` as `patch` either way.
- `packages/client`'s `packages.uninstall(id)` exposes no keep-data option, so an SDK caller cannot keep the tables at all. Not in scope here (no misbehaviour at a door); noted for the seat.

## Verification

All readings at head `5ce4a3c1`, base `e78d7057`. Evidence: the project's `pm-orders/server/evidence/26857/`.

<details><summary>Red first on base: 40 runtime and 3 rest cases fail, exactly the refusal cases</summary>

`packages.ts` and `package-routes.ts` restored from `e78d7057` (tree only), the new tests at head:

- runtime (`packages-write-doors-closed-query` + the draft-door and arity files): `Test Files 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`, `Tests 40 failed | 46 passed (86)`. First failure: `expected 400, got {"status":200,"body":{"success":true,"data":{"packageId":"com.acme.app","success":true,"registryRemoved":true,"persisted":{"success":true}}}}` for `?keepdata=true`. The misspelled install flag: `expected 400, got … 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT "Package 'com.acme.app' already exists"`.
- rest (`package-publish-closed-query`): `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`.

Every preservation and `403` case passed on base, so the refusals are the only thing the diff moves.
</details>

<details><summary>Real door, real tables: base drops the table on ?keepdata=true, head keeps it</summary>

One-off probe, not committed (`zz-probe-26857.test.ts` in the evidence folder): the dispatcher over `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` on SQLite, a package owning one object `repairs_ticket` with one row, then `DELETE /packages/com.example.repairs` with each query.

| query | base `e78d7057` | head `5ce4a3c1` |
|---|---|---|
| `keepdata=true` | `200`, table gone | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming `keepdata`, table and its 1 row kept |
| `keepData=true` (control) | `200`, table and row kept | `200`, table and row kept |
| none (control) | `200`, table dropped | `200`, table dropped |
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the helper forced to answer nothing reds the refusal cases only</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages.ts`, anchor `const message = unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage(query, declared);` replaced by a constant `undefined` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `3bb82a0d7c5d` to `8d620d85fe51`): `Test Files 2 failed (2)`, `Tests 46 failed | 29 passed (75)` over the new file and the draft-door file (40 + 6 refusal cases red, every preservation and `403` case green). Restored: blob after restore `3bb82a0d7c5d` = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests import the runtime source, so no build sits between.
</details>

<details><summary>Green at head: package suites, typecheck, lint, test:repo</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: exit 0, `Test Files 462 passed (462)`, `Tests 7532 passed | 19 skipped (7551)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: exit 0, `Test Files 329 passed (329)`, `Tests 6518 passed | 326 skipped (6844)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint packages/runtime packages/rest --no-inline-config`: exit 0.
- `vitest run --project repo` in `packages/runtime`, `packages/rest`, `packages/core`: exit 0 each (6, 5 and 3 files; 83, 280 + 18 skipped, 947 tests).
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates: 61 of 61 run, all exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `5ce4a3c1` derived 61 families; every one run, exit code captured before any pipe, all exit 0. Two had container prerequisites on the first pass (exit 3) and were re-run after meeting them: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (positive control `621a4876` fetched; 48 cases pass) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (7 packages without `dist` built; 112 entries across 69 packages load). `--ran`: `61 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
</details>

<details><summary>Full dogfood once at head: 332 of 333 run files green; the one red never touches a package door and passes alone</summary>

Closure built (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`, exit 0), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock at `5ce4a3c1`: VERDICT command-exit 1 (held 19m00s), `Test Files 1 failed | 332 passed | 3 skipped (336)`, `Tests 2 failed | 2704 passed | 20 skipped (2726)`.

The red file is `test/packaged-action-disabled-dispatch-live.dogfood.test.ts` (acceptance[0]: `expected true to be false` on `after.done`; acceptance[5]: a different `sys_metadata` row id after the cold boot). It drives the packaged-action disable switch over `/actions`, `/meta` and MCP and calls no `/packages` route, so this diff does not reach it. Re-run alone at the same head and build: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 8 passed (8)`. Read as order or load dependent within the full battery on a shared box, not as this change's consequence.
</details>
